meta.description: Stops DeepSeek Harness generation as soon as the same string repeats >=10 times in a row, and commits the partial answer. Fenced, inline and indented code share one relaxed threshold (threshold x codeBlockMultiplier); repeat counts can follow unit length through a piecewise table or a JS module; the whitelist, the detection window and the table-derived unit lengths are written back automatically, so settings changes need no restart. Verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (CLI and desktop), host API >= 0.1.1.

en.addPlaceholder: Characters or substrings (separate with spaces / commas)
en.advancedThresholdFileHint: A JS file exporting repeatCount(length) -> count (.js / .cjs are safest). It runs inside the DSH host process — point it only at a file you trust; the load result appears in the host startup log.
en.codeBlockMultiplierHint: Fenced, inline and indented code regions are all judged by threshold x this multiplier. Tiers: 2 or more = relaxed (default 4); 1 = same strictness as outside; 0 = do not detect inside code regions at all. Range {min}-{max}; detection details are in the README.
en.continuePromptHint: User message injected into that session when you press "Send continue instruction" (empty = default wording)
en.derivedDiagTable: derived: window {window} · max unit length {maxUnit} (from last row)
en.empty: The ignore-list is empty: every character counts.
en.errCross: Must not be smaller than the minimum unit length (currently {min}).
en.errCrossMin: Must not be larger than the maximum unit length (currently {max}).
en.errRowCount: Repeats must be an integer between 2 and 1000.
en.errRowOrder: "To" must be smaller than the next row's "To" (ranges must increase and not overlap).
en.errSubstringDuplicate: That entry is already in the ignore-list.
en.errSubstringEmpty: Enter a non-empty character or substring.
en.errSubstringTooLong: Entry too long: at most {maxLen} code points each.
en.errThresholdFile: Enter the module file path (empty means the module is disabled).
en.intro: Generation stops when the same string repeats consecutively up to the threshold. Changes below take effect immediately and persist to settings.yaml.
en.legacySkipCodeBlocksHint: This config disables code tiering (skipCodeBlocks=false, equivalent to multiplier 1); editing the multiplier above takes over and clears that legacy key.
en.maxUnitLengthHint: Longest repeating unit recognized, in characters after cleaning (whitespace and whitelisted characters are removed). Range {min}–{max}.
en.minUnitLengthHint: Shortest repeating unit considered, in characters. Range {min}–{max}; 1 catches single-character loops.
en.monitorReasoningHint: Repeats inside reasoning burn tokens too, so they are monitored by default.
en.monitorToolArgumentsHint: Off by default: repeated characters are common in JSON / base64 arguments.
en.note: "Reset to defaults" clears every user setting on this page and restores the code defaults.
en.noticeCodeRegion: inside a code region (relaxed by the multiplier)
en.noticeHostMissing: Stop notices are inactive: the host half is not loaded yet
en.noticeHostMissingHint: The notice channel is served by the host (/dsh-dupguard/notifications) and the request failed. Host code loads only at process start, so restart dsh web; detection and stopping are unaffected.
en.notifyOnStop: Show a notice when generation is stopped
en.notifyOnStopHint: Shows a notice when generation is stopped, with the workspace, session name and repeated string of the stopped session — regardless of which session you are viewing — and lets you send a continue instruction.
en.remoteHint: Settings editing requires a local connection: open the DSH page through the local address (127.0.0.1) and retry. On remote browsers, or when this DSH build disables settings writes, detection keeps the host configuration.
en.riskAcknowledge: I understand the risks and want to continue
en.riskDescription: Advanced mode executes the JavaScript file you specify inside the DSH host process: that file has the same privileges as DSH and can read or write files, make network requests, or run arbitrary code. Only use a source you fully trust — the plugin cannot verify the file. This feature is still experimental and its interface or behaviour may change.
en.saveFailed: Save failed: the host did not accept the value; check the input or the DSH host log.
en.stripWhitespaceHint: Remove all whitespace (newlines included) before detection, so separated repeats are still recognized.
en.systemNotifyBody: Repeated output detected and generation stopped. Click to open.
en.systemNotifyHint: Sends an extra system notification (browser notification → Windows toast / macOS Notification Center) when generation is stopped. Only fires while the DSH page is hidden; the text never includes the workspace or session name. The browser asks for permission the first time you enable it.
en.systemNotifyPermissionDefault: Browser notification permission: not granted yet (toggle it off and on to ask again)
en.systemNotifyPermissionDenied: Browser notification permission: denied (allow it in the browser site settings)
en.systemNotifyPermissionUnsupported: System notifications are not available in this environment (browser API missing)
en.systemNotifyTestFailed: Test notification failed: the browser has not granted notification permission
en.systemNotifyTestOk: Test notification sent (if you do not see it, check Windows notification settings / Focus assist)
en.tableHint: The "From" column is derived (first row 1, then previous "To" + 1); the last row's "To" is the maximum detected length. At most {max} rows.
en.tableMaxUnitHint: In table mode the maximum repeating-unit length comes from the last row's "To" — no separate field.
en.thresholdByLengthHint: One entry per row: "<maxLength>:<count>", comma-separated, optional "*:<count>" fallback. Example: 1:40, 2:30, 8:12, *:10.
en.thresholdFallbackHint: The base threshold is editable in simple mode only; in this mode it is just the fallback (uncovered lengths without "*", or when the module is unavailable). Current value: {threshold}.
en.thresholdHint: Stop once a string repeats this many times in a row (>= semantics). Range {min}–{max}.
en.thresholdModeHint: Simple uses the threshold below; the table maps length ranges to counts; advanced mode (experimental) runs a JS file you point at and asks for a confirmation when selected.
en.title: Repetition Guard
en.unavailable: Settings unavailable: no data for the Dupguard section was received. Verify the plugin is mounted (the host log should contain "[dupguard] 常驻插件 apply 开始") and that this DSH build exposes a settings channel (0.1.7+ needs a plugin Config export), then refresh the page.
en.whitelistHint: Enter single characters or whole substrings — each entry is classified automatically: one non-whitespace code point goes to the character list, everything else to the substring list. Separate entries with spaces or commas. Substrings are literal (case-sensitive, no regex); each entry ≤ {maxLen} code points, at most {maxCount} entries. For whitespace, edit the config file.
en.windowWarn: ⚠ The derived window needs {need} characters but is capped at {current}; units longer than {effective} characters cannot be detected — lower the threshold, code-block multiplier or max unit length.
